items.title: Final Festival — Week 2: Cross Versus
items.summary: The official Final Festival of Universes (Last World Tournament) is underway. It started on 30 October 2026, after a free 10th-anniversary update on 27 October. This week’s Time Patrol game mode is Cross Versus (9–15 November). Raise camaraderie with Trunks, the Supreme Kai of Time or Fu to unlock special illustrations. A commemorative Gi and medal from the festival can unlock related items in Xenoverse 3 (2027) through Bandai Namco ID linkage. The official Japanese information post lists the in-game event through 15 February 2027, 8:59 AM JST (9:59 AM Perth), and states that the maximum Star Coins obtainable is about 25 times the previous tournament.
items.weeks_note: Game Mode of the Week timetable as posted by Xeno Time Patrol for the official Final Festival. Week badges update automatically from the dates below.

items.title: RAID: vs Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan) (Lite)
items.summary: Official raid on now (re-checked against the official information post id1853 on 10 November 2026). PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and Steam: 5 Nov, 8:00 PM – 11 Nov, 10:00 PM PT (6 Nov, 12:00 PM – 12 Nov, 2:00 PM Perth, UTC+8). Xbox (official Japanese clock): 6 Nov, 4:00 AM – 12 Nov, 6:00 AM JST (6 Nov, 3:00 AM – 12 Nov, 5:00 AM Perth, UTC+8). Participation rewards: Hercule Badge (Common) ×1 and TP Medals ×50. Higher damage tiers also award more TP and STP medals, plus titles, costumes, accessories, artwork and Super Souls (see the official post). Join via the Time Rift (big blue hole) on the west side of the Shop Area.

items.title: 10th anniversary login bonus
items.summary: A limited login bonus bundled with the 27 October free update (update #23) is still running. It ends on 16 November 2026 at 11:59 PM JST (10:59 PM Perth). Official rewards listed on the information post include loading-screen artwork, STP Medals and the Xenoverse 2 10th Anniversary celebration cake hat. [CMS edit test]

items.title: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 — the final Xenoverse 2 DLC
items.summary: Bandai Namco’s final post-launch DLC for Xenoverse 2. Officially includes playable Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled) and Supreme Kai of Time (Ultra Supervillain), Ultra Time Patrol Battles, and the Gallery of Time.

items.title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 announced for 2027
items.summary: Unveiled at Dragon Ball Games Battle Hour 2026. Planned for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and PC (Steam) in 2027.
